claims.statement: EudraGMDP is maintained by the EMA with content supplied by EEA national competent authorities and public access to manufacturing and compliance information.
The public database exposes operation-level search dimensions including manufacturing, batch, packaging and importation operations.

economics.acquisition_route: Start with Polish biotech incubators and one narrow analytical test category
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 800 annual EU engagements at 10000 PLN net revenue could generate 8m PLN revenue; a 60% founder stake could exceed 5m PLN in years 6-9
economics.founder_time: 3-5 hours/day; all GMP judgments stay with qualified professionals
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 60-78% after pharmacist and quality-review contractor costs
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 5000-15000 PLN readiness fee plus 3-5% of accepted contract value
economics.retention_or_repeat: Sponsors return for development, validation, release and stability campaigns

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Observed capability, lead-time and successful-transfer data create a trusted capacity map unavailable in the public registry
fingerprint.customer: Small pharmaceutical, biotech and clinical-trial supply companies in Poland/EU
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Clinical-supply consultants, biotech incubators and specialist regulatory advisers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: EudraGMDP-anchored facility matching, capability questionnaires, confidential data rooms and capacity reservations; no quality decision by the platform
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Sponsor pays a readiness fee and commission when a qualified facility accepts a reserved slot
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A batch or trial milestone is delayed because a suitable GMP operation lacks available capacity

founder_fit: Health interest and data background are relevant
A narrow matching layer can start part-time
Expert partners can cover regulated judgment
risks: The platform must avoid regulated advice

structure.control_point: verified operation-specific availability and technology-transfer readiness record
structure.critical_dependency: Facilities must share capacity while sponsors and qualified persons retain all regulated responsibilities

thesis: Match small EU medicine and clinical-supply companies to documented GMP laboratories or manufacturers with reservable analytical, packaging or batch-release capacity, starting with one operation type.
title: GMP Release-Testing Capacity Exchange
uncertainties: Capacity scarcity, transaction frequency and willingness to pay are unvalidated
The safest initial operation type is unknown
